author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Spend your time mentoring good junior engineers, spend your time improving your AI agents. Time invest in them compound.

Don't waste your time helping the bad junior engineers to improve, just replace them with AI agents, that's the most efficient use of your precious attentions as a tech lead.

shared_article.title: Why I Hate Micromanaging People but Love Micromanaging AI
